_meta.source: Statistics Canada table 33-10-0270-01, Experimental estimates for business openings and closures for Canada, provinces and territories, census metropolitan areas, seasonally adjusted (monthly, January 2015 to July 2026). Downloaded 17 November 2026.
_meta.coverage: St. Catharines-Niagara is published for all business-sector industries only; industry detail is published for Ontario. Closing businesses include temporary closures (a business with no payroll this month that had one last month); exits are closures not followed by a reopening, published for some series only.
